scope_rules: Separate stored artifacts from agent-connected actions and from payloads transferred to a target.
No new binary becomes an agent action merely because it is installed or found in PATH.
All target-facing and cloud-facing execution remains behind the existing ASM proposal, approval, scope, profile, rate, timeout, STOP and audit gates.
Source archives collected for review are static-review material only; do not import or execute them until individually reviewed.
No C2, persistence, social engineering, malware, online credential guessing, session interception, customer-data modification, or log tampering.
